description: From the beginning we’ve been running this campaign like a start-up. We are selling a product: Kasie Whitener for US Senate. One million South Carolinians know our government doesn’t work for us. We’re out there raising our families, helping our communities, and building our businesses. And we know what it takes to lead. So let’s work together to elect a citizen who will do that.
title: The Business of Our Campaign - Kasie South Carolina
